content:
Flying high!

Today, our X-59 quiet supersonic X-59 aircraft traveled from Birmingham, Alabama, to Daytona Beach, Florida. The aircraft aims to fly faster than sound with just a gentle thump rather than a sonic boom — helping usher in a new era of faster air travel.

We're prepping to feature X-59 at MAX POWER and will provide updates soon!

description: NASA’s X-59 experimental supersonic aircraft in flight over the ocean, seen from the side with its long, needle-thin nose pointing left. The aircraft is silver-white on top with a dark blue underside. Puffy white clouds and a strip of coastline fill the background.
